item.title: Choose the device for activity check-ins
item.summary: Ask Murph to follow activities from Garmin, Oura, or Fitbit when setting up an activity check-in, or change the device on an existing check-in.
item.details: Check-ins wait for matching activity to sync from the selected device. WHOOP filters remain available, and check-ins without a selected device continue to follow all activity sources.
